integrity: Exact martingale and analytic derivations; finite checks supplement but do not substitute for proof; related scalar CLT and constant-p functional theorems fully acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Smooth mean-zero periodic logarithmic perturbations of critical repetition only; weak Skorokhod functional convergence, not a strong coupling; possible equivalences in unindexed reinforced-process literature; phase labels can coincide when the forcing has smaller fundamental period.
title: Phase-dependent Brownian clocks for critically modulated elephant walks
